root_cause.text: In the `__do_adjtimex()` function, the leap state update unconditionally references the global core timekeeper (`&tk_core`) instead of using the passed `tkd` parameter, causing incorrect modification of the core timekeeper when the function is called on an auxiliary timekeeper.
root_cause.evidence: The patch replaces `tk_update_leap_state_all(&tk_core)` with `tk_update_leap_state_all(tkd)` in the else branch of `__do_adjtimex()`. The CVE description explicitly states that "when __do_ajdtimex() was introduced to handle adjtimex for any timekeeper, this reference to tk_core was not updated" and that the bug leads to lock debugging warnings due to writing the sequence lock without holding the associated spinlock.
